Welcome to St Anthony's Catholic Primary School and Preschool
Welcome toSt Anthony's
Welcome to St Anthony's Catholic Primary School and Preschool!
We are a friendly, family-centred Catholic school with fantastic outdoor learning resources. We have delightful pupils, supportive parents and an excellent relationship with our local Catholic church - St Margaret Mary in Park Gate, which is led by Fr Ansel D'Mello.
At St Anthony’s we aim to live out our mission statement, guided and led by our Catholic ethos that places Catholic Social Teaching principles of human dignity and the common good at the heart of our school.
Our ambition is for our children to be kind leaders of the future, who lead by example. With our support, we hope they will grow into young people and adults who will make a positive difference in society.
We welcome visits to our school and we hope to meet you soon.
Mrs Katrina Straker, Headteacher

YR & Preschool - Silly Scott Show
Explore our Forest and Farm Schools
St Anthony's has wonderful grounds and we are making good use of these with a Forest School and Farm School.
All of our children, from our pre-school up to Year 6, love visiting the farm school and tending to the animals’ different needs. Our animals are well cared for and adore the attention from the children.
Our Forest School is both an outdoor classroom and an exciting place for creative play. The children love toasting marshmallows round the campfire, building dens and exploring the wooded area with fairy doors hidden amongst the tree roots.

Welcome to St Anthony's Catholic Primary School and Preschool
Music Development Plan
Music Development Plan
Music is an integral part of school life at St Anthony's. The aim of music in the curriculum is to provide opportunities to develop the skills of investigation, appreciation, exploration, creative composition and performance. Based on the National Curriculum, our intent is to provide opportunities for children to participate in a variety of musical experiences through which we endeavour to build up the confidence of all children to perform to the very best of their ability.
Music is also directed towards specific events such as hymns and songs for assemblies and masses and music performances such as our Christmas productions and the Easter passion play.
In addition to this, our children can learn to play a music instrument through private lessons with our visiting peripatetic music teacher. Children can learn the recorder and keyboard in Year 2, then broaden to acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass guitar, flute, clarinet and saxophone in Key Stage 2. A large percentage of our pupils also enter ABRSM, Trinity and Rock School exams, with a high level of success. Those who play an instrument are invited to join our school orchestra. Our choir, St Anthony's Singing Stars, rehearses weekly after school and performs at a range of community events. Both the orchestra and choir perform in school asssemblies and in our annual music concert 'Music on a Summer's Eve'.
Please see attached our Music Development Plan following our review of Music in 2023-2024.

Welcome to St Anthony's Catholic Primary School and Preschool
Parents Evening Booking
Parents Evening Booking
Your Account Details
We will initially generate an account for you using the email address you have provided to the school for communications. When we do this, you will receive an email inviting you to create a password for your account.
If you have not received the message, check your junk/spam folder and ensure that you have added the junipereducation.org domain to your safe senders list.
Logging in
You can access our booking system at any time using this link:
You will be prompted to log in by entering your email address and password. If you have not yet set your password, you can request a password reset email by clicking ‘Forgot your password’. You should use the email address you have registered with the school.
Making a Booking
The child you are booking for will show in the top right-hand corner of the screen. If you have more than one child at our school, you will see a circle for each child. Simply click on the relevant circle to select the child you want to make a booking for.
Find the teacher and time you’d like to book and click to reserve the time slot. The selection will show in green with the word “RESERVED”. The time allocated for each slot will be automatically populated.
Please note: the slot will only be reserved for 10 minutes.
To confirm the reservation you’ll need to click on the save button in the bottom right corner.
